code:
Plans read backwards from English:

Rightmost, bottom-most operator runs FIRST
  (table/index access — Scans, Seeks)

...data flows LEFT and UP...

Leftmost operator (SELECT) is the
  final result, handed back last
caption: Getting this backwards is why plans look incomprehensible at first.

code:
Arrow thickness  = row count flowing
  through that point (NOT cost, NOT time)

Cost percentage  = optimizer's ESTIMATE
  of relative cost within THIS plan
  (a lead, not proof — can be wrong)
caption: Two different signals — don't read one as the other.

subtitle: When the optimizer's guess and reality disagree.
